# Undertale Soul Quiz

> Undertale Soul Quiz is an independent, unofficial browser-based fan quiz that compares seven soul virtues across 66 original scored statements and two unscored final checks.

The site returns clean Markdown from each canonical public page when a client sends `Accept: text/markdown`. The interactive quiz itself requires a browser with JavaScript and user input. Answers, progress, scoring, and generated result images stay in the browser; there is no account system, application server, or database.

## When to use this site

Use Undertale Soul Quiz when a user wants to:

- take a long-form, unofficial Undertale-inspired virtue quiz;
- compare Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance in one result;
- see a Primary Soul, Secondary Virtue, full seven-score spread, Shadow, and Pairing;
- save or share a result image generated in the browser;
- find an entertainment-focused quiz that does not require an account or upload answers.

Do not use this site as an official Undertale source, a scientific personality assessment, a diagnosis, or a substitute for the original test by Jaden.

To call the experience, send the user to https://undertalesoulquiz.com/ in a JavaScript-capable browser. To retrieve page information as an agent, request a public page with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Core pages

- [Interactive quiz and result guide](https://undertalesoulquiz.com/): Start or resume the 68-response experience and read how the seven-dimension result works.
- [Credits](https://undertalesoulquiz.com/credits): Read attribution, unofficial-project status, reference-source boundaries, and independent-original implementation details.
- [Privacy](https://undertalesoulquiz.com/privacy): Understand browser-local answers, LocalStorage, Canvas share images, email, analytics, and cookie behavior.
- [Terms](https://undertalesoulquiz.com/terms): Read the entertainment disclaimer, fan-project status, availability terms, and intellectual-property boundary.
- [Contact](https://undertalesoulquiz.com/contact): Find the public email for feedback, bugs, accessibility, and rights inquiries.
